bio: Surrounded by beautiful parklands overlooking the River Wear, Lumley Castle serves as one of the finest hotel and dining destinations in the North East. Enjoy the quintessential British tradition of Afternoon Tea in the Castle's stylish Library Bar or Knight Restaurant.  Your Afternoon Tea spread will include assorted finger sandwiches, scrumptious cakes, homemade scones with jam and cream, alongside your choice of freshly brewed tea or coffee.
